ambient: A layer at the edge lifts a little and lies back down.
Something crosses the surface above and doesn't go over the side.
The edge continues away from you in both directions, at the same thickness.
description: The world here is a surface with a thickness, and you have got to the side of it. The thickness is about the width of a hand. Everything is painted on the top and it's painted well and the edge shows the layers, and you can count them, and there are more than there should be.
name: The Edge Of The Flat

looks: Layers. Pressed. Each one a whole world done in a very thin coat.
You count eleven and lose the count and it's more than eleven.
The top one is the one you have been living on and it's the thinnest.
objects.name: the edge

looks: Nothing. Not dark. Nothing, in the way the back of a picture is nothing.
It supports the surface without touching it.
You put a hand under and the hand is on the top again.
objects.name: underneath
